messages:
incident-bot: Pager: elevated 5xx rate observed on infer-gateway-prod across region us-east-1. %5xx = 14% over last 2m, rolling latency spike. Auto-escalation to on-call.

sam_oncall: on it. gathering high-level impact. is this affecting hosted API customers or just Dedicated pools?

liz_eng: seeing many 502/504 at gateway layer, backend runner returning 5xx. stack traces show SIGSEGV in model-runner v2.3.1 on multiple hosts.

aj_infra: confirmed nodes with repeated oom/kills too. kube evictions around the same time for pod group model-runner-enc-*. possible memory blowup.

sam_oncall: tagging @ken_ml for model-level context — any recent rollout or quant change pushed to v2.3.1?

ken_ml: no intentional model change in prod. But yesterday we rolled a new attention-kernel patch to v2.3.1 on a limited ring. Could be related. sending logs now.

maya_support: customer-impact note: multiple SEV1 support tickets showing generation timeouts and 5xx. CS reported a major enterprise customer seeing FAILED requests to embeddings endpoint.

oliver_prod: turning on traffic diversion policy to fallback model variant (enc-legacy) for affected routes. Doing gradual shift 10% -> 50% if error rate improves.

sam_oncall: please paste the minimal reproducer/log snippet and the relevant OOM/segfault stack here.

liz_eng: log excerpt:
```
[2026-03-16T03:21:08Z] runner[pid=7412]: segfault at 0x7f3a1c, rip=0x7fb2a4d2
[2026-03-16T03:21:09Z] kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 7412 (model-runner) total-vm:1.8G
[2026-03-16T03:21:09Z] runner: 5xx -> client=api-gateway request_id=abc123 prompt_len=2048
```

aj_infra: nodes affected show elevated page cache and thrashing. I’m increasing swap target on the pool and draining hot pods for repro. Also nudging kube to prefer lower-packing for these runtimes.

ken_ml: hypothesis: attention kernel regression causing KV cache growth per-token in corner case (long prefixes). Can we check sequence length distribution for recent requests?

sam_oncall: @oliver_prod will monitor fallback rollout. If error drops under 2% at 50% traffic, we keep fallback. If not, escalate to rollback.

oliver_prod: started rollout at 03:23Z -> 10% now. routing rule: if infer.model==enc-v2.3.1 -> enc-legacy.

deploy-bot: routing-change applied: route-id=rt-330210; 10% shift complete.

liz_eng: quick metric: at 03:26Z after 10% shift, global 5xx dropped from 14% -> 9%. still high. collecting more traces.

maya_support: flagging impacted accounts and reaching out with status: "We're investigating; temporary fallback applied; performance may be reduced." Want a short blurb for customers.

sam_oncall: draft blurb: "We're seeing elevated error rates caused by a runtime regression in our model runtime. We've applied a fallback to a previous model variant for affected traffic and are monitoring. We'll update with remediation timeline." Approve?

maya_support: LGTM, sending now.

ken_ml: running targeted debug build on a reproduce node with long prefix to validate KV growth. If confirmed, we need to revert the kernel patch roll and hotfix.

aj_infra: increasing diagnostic logging and enabling core dumps to a secure bucket for affected runner pods. Will limit retention.

sam_oncall: decision tree: if 5xx > 5% after 50% fallback or we see continued segfaults on fallback, initiate immediate rollback of v2.3.1 kernel patch and trigger emergency deploy. @liz_eng keep us posted on repro.

liz_eng: repro complete on a dev pod with synthetic long prompt; observed same OOM pattern. Bisection suggests attention-kernel commit aa1f3b introduced unsafe mem access.

sam_oncall: copy. prep rollback PR and ready hotpatch. assign to liz_eng + ken_ml + aj_infra for rollback test. set priority: P0.

oliver_prod: increasing fallback to 50% now. deploy-bot: apply route 50%.

deploy-bot: routing-change applied: route-id=rt-330210; 50% shift complete.

liz_eng: after 50% shift, 5xx down to 3.2% and latency normalizing. core dumps uploaded to s3://internal-cores/330210/.

sam_oncall: looks like fallback helped. proceeding with rollback plan to revert attention-kernel commit from the release pipeline. ETA for hotfix rollforward ~20m.

ken_ml: prepping unit/regression test to trap this pattern. will add to CI to prevent future regression.

maya_support: updating customers with progress: "Fallback increased to 50% and errors decreasing; engineering working on hotfix; next update in 30 minutes."

sam_oncall: closing loop: keep this thread for postmortem. we'll run RCA after hotfix. great work triaging quickly. :thumbsup:
